thread:
taylor: Hey team — baby ETA July 18. I'm in Canada (Toronto) and want to start leave a few days before. Can someone outline the EI process, what Redwood top-up looks like here, and any payroll/benefits steps? Also thinking about a phased 60% return for 4 weeks.

asa: Congrats @taylor! For Canada: you should apply for EI parental benefits via Service Canada after the birth and grab your EI claim number. Redwood provides a company top-up: first 6 weeks we top up EI to 100% of base pay (you must be designated primary caregiver), then weeks 7-12 we provide a 50% salary supplement on top of EI. Please confirm primary vs secondary in the portal.

mika: Practical docs: upload the EI confirmation (claim number) and the physician's due date note to the HR portal. HR will issue the ROE (Record of Employment) to Service Canada. To avoid payroll timing issues submit docs at least 10 business days before the payroll cutoff — payroll runs on the last business day of the month here.

 d ina: On benefits: add the child to the health plan within 30 days. Pension/CPP: employer contributions follow pay periods; if you receive company-paid top-up that counts toward contributions. Vacation accrual continues during company-paid weeks per our policy. For unpaid stretches we have LOA processes you can request.

taylor: Thanks. How do I request the phased 60% return? Does that affect EI?

asa: Phased return: submit a phased-return LOA request in the portal (select "reduced hours"). We coordinate with payroll and benefits. EI rules differ — sometimes a partial return affects EI entitlement; we recommend contacting Service Canada and HR will attach a note. We'll also calculate pro-rated pay and benefits.

mika: Ops/coverage: please create a 1-page runbook with daily check-ins, three critical PRs, and an "alerts" block listing pagerduty names. If you want a contractor, include dates, skills (backend Go + infra), and overlap days. Vendor bench can usually supply a contractor in ~7-10 business days.

 taylor: Got it. Also: is there lactation room booking support and any campus resources I should know about?

 d ina: Yes — request a lactation room key via workplace-ops. We also have a child-care referral list and a one-time childcare stipend for new parents (submit receipts). HR will DM the stipend form.

as a: Thanks team — uploaded the runbook draft and marked primary caregiver. I'll DM the EI claim when it's issued. Appreciate the help!
